# konnect_portal_team_developer (Resource)

PortalTeamDeveloper Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_portal_team_developer" "my_portalteamdeveloper" {
  developer_id = "df120cb4-f60b-47bc-a2f8-6a28e6a3c63b"
  portal_id    = "f32d905a-ed33-46a3-a093-d8f536af9a8a"
  team_id      = "d32d905a-ed33-46a3-a093-d8f536af9a8a"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `developer_id` (String) ID of the developer. Requires replacement if changed.
- `portal_id` (String) The Portal identifier. Requires replacement if changed.
- `team_id` (String) ID of the team. Requires replacement if changed.
